text:
jess (infra): seeing elevated 5xx from eu-west GPU fleet, autoscaler not catching up :frowning:
marco (oncall): confirmed, control-plane shows govpool-eu-west at 92% GPU mem and spike in evictions
sophie (eng-sre): graph looks like degraded NVLink fabric + retry storms. pods are restarting on same nodes
jess (infra): can we steer traffic off before more OOMs? want to avoid cascading evacs
ryan (runtime): we can change gslb routing policy weights for the affected pool. propose shift 60% eu-west -> na-west, 40% -> eu-south as soft failover
anita (product): what's user impact? any customers pinned to eu-west only? :thinking_face:
marco (oncall): enterprise customer X has region pinning but we have fallback config; will notify them
jess (infra): ok. prepping policy change. will run a 5-min canary at 30% first
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued: gslb/policies/region-shift-1788456789
ryan (runtime): command to push quick policy (rolling):
```
# temporarily shift weights to reduce load on eu-west
curl -X PATCH https://gslb.internal/api/policies/region-weights \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $GSLB_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"eu-west": 0.2, "na-west": 0.5, "eu-south": 0.3}'
```
jess (infra): executing canary now @marco
marco (oncall): see canary at 1788456805, telemetry shows request latency stable but tokens/sec in eu-west dropped 28%
sophie (eng-sre): OOM events reduced but still some pod restarts. autoscaler pulled 3 nodes but scheduling failed due to kernel oops on one host
ryan (runtime): opening host issue with infra-allocator, marking 1 host in eu-west unschedulable
jess (infra): okay escalate to capacity drain for that rack, shifting another 10% off eu-west
deploy-bot: Policy change applied: eu-west=0.1, na-west=0.6, eu-south=0.3 (change id gslb-1788456789-1)
anita (product): can we throttle background heavy batching traffic to reduce pressure? That would help latency-sensitive customers
jess (infra): yes; adding route-level throttle for batch routes in eu-west only
ryan (runtime): throttle config snippet:
```
{
  "route": "/v1/generate/batch",
  "region": "eu-west",
  "max_concurrent": 20,
  "burst": 40
}
```
sophie (eng-sre): good. after throttle and weight shift, errors dropped to 0.8% from 4.6% in eu-west
marco (oncall): notif posted to #customers-ops for pinned customers, CS will take follow-up
jess (infra): cost note — shifting to na-west raises per-token cost by ~12% at current pricing. we should monitor billing delta if this persists >6h
anita (product): ok keep me updated; we'll prioritize minimizing end-user disruption
ryan (runtime): tracking issue created: infra/1788456789 - 'eu-west GPU fabric degradation -> gslb weight shift and throttles' with mitigation steps
sophie (eng-sre): next actions: 1) keep weights at current for 15m observation 2) evict unhealthy host 3) coordinate kernel patch with infra 4) revert throttle when stable
jess (infra): setting reminder to reassess at +15m
marco (oncall): ack. I'll watch SLO dashboards and escalate if errors >1.5% for 5m
deploy-bot: Incident tag added: incident/2026-03-gpu-euw-1788456789
jess (infra): thanks all. ping me in thread for any new symptoms. :thumbsup:
marco (oncall): thanks — monitoring
anita (product): thx team
ryan (runtime): will follow up with postmortem draft once kernel root cause confirmed
sophie (eng-sre): adding log snippets to the ticket and will attach scheduler events
jess (infra): closing this thread for now, will reopen if we need further shifts
